create_s3_destination: create a FocusS3Destination instance with prefix and config containing bucket_name for S3 export
build_object_key: build an S3 object key from a FocusTimeWindow and filename with date and optional hour partitioning
upload_to_s3: upload binary content to an S3 bucket using boto3 with configurable region and credentials
deliver_export: deliver serialized export content to S3 asynchronously with time-windowed object key generation
configure_s3_client: configure a boto3 S3 client with optional region, endpoint URL, and AWS credential parameters
